options.name: block_period
options.description: Enter the number of seconds that you want to block subsequent requests from the client after the FortiWeb appliance detects a CSRF attack. This setting is available only if 'security_action' is set to 'block-period'.

options.name: js_request_check
options.description: Enabling this option will run another script to modify the page’s native XMLHttpRequest function and add the CSRF parameter tknfv onto it.

options.name: name
options.description: name of the CSRF protection rule

options.name: security_action
options.description: Select which action FortiWeb takes when it detects a missing or incorrect anti-CSRF parameter.

options.name: severity
options.description: Select which severity level FortiWeb uses when it logs a CSRF attack.
